title: Finding
description: One claim, from any lane/persona. Added 2026-09-19. classification/classification_taxonomy are cross-checked against schemas/verdict-taxonomies.json by schema_validate.py, not by this file alone, because different lane families legitimately need different verdict vocabularies (adversarial refutation vs static-hardening vs memory-safety disposition) -- forcing one global enum here would paper over a real, deliberate design difference (see 15-deployment-hardening's static-vs-observed taxonomy vs 07/08/09's REFUTED/CONFIRMED/etc.).

persona_id.description: e.g. redteam-l4-general, iac-cloud-terraform-auditor, bash-checker, permission-checker. Domain-prefixed convention decided 2026-09-19 (design-v3.md §5.5) to avoid collisions once IaC/red-team/blue-team/verifier personas share this field across lanes.

domain.description: free-text short label, e.g. injection, iam, memory-safety, supply-chain, secrets.

disa_stig_id.description: Added 2026-09-19 -- DISA STIGs/SRGs are public-domain (17 U.S.C. §105) and may be vendored/quoted per design-v3.md §5.4, unlike CIS. Only from a curated, version-pinned reference file, not recalled from training knowledge.

nist_800_53_control.description: Added 2026-09-19, e.g. AC-3. Often too high-level on its own to support a completeness claim -- see design-v3.md §5.4 on asymmetric standards coverage.

standard_refs.description: Every field optional and nullable -- a finding is not required to have every taxonomy, and must not force one that doesn't genuinely apply (e.g. do not force an attack_technique onto a pure memory-safety finding with no attacker-facing technique yet).

classification_taxonomy.description: Key into schemas/verdict-taxonomies.json#/taxonomies -- the named vocabulary this finding's classification is drawn from.

classification.description: Must be a member of schemas/verdict-taxonomies.json#/taxonomies/<classification_taxonomy> -- checked by schema_validate.py, not expressible as a plain JSON Schema enum here since it depends on the sibling classification_taxonomy field.

attack_scenario.description: Narrative only. Never a working exploit/PoC code block, and never remediation code -- verified remediation is 11-remediation-proposal's job, not any discovery/refutation/hardening persona's.

requires_executed_verification.description: True if this finding's classification/confidence should not be trusted without an actual compiled/executed test (per the RT-FC04-002 lesson and the open question about kill-chain claims needing the same bar as 09's reused-binary rule).

method.description: e.g. 'compiled fresh in audit-native:local via images/audit-native/run.ps1, ran and observed exit code'.
